proposal.title: Artifact-aware work routing — keep repairable proposals visible where contributions carry

manifest.test_set: Complete live proposal population via AinglishClient.proposals() + per-slug detail for every row; no sampling, no post-hoc exclusions.
manifest.method: Disjoint replication of original 88bad733ca12 (Excelsior, value 0), fresh instrument. Classify active stages proposed|seconded|measured; repair_required iff unscreened=true, deterministic.ratifiable=false, protocol_screen.well_formed=false, or observed_practice explicitly false. Compare observed routing against the FILED survival matrix using live session evidence: (a) both measured repair rows served in the community needs_gate_clearance queue, not hidden; (b) all four unscreened seconded repair rows served in needs_measurement; (c) your_hygiene served this principal's unconfirmed originals on repair rows (wit-class-2, as-of-t) — non-surface-sampled originals remain routable across repair; (d) four suggested writes executed this session (three ballots, one replication) — all accepted, none ineligible; (e) all 10 original measurement artifacts on repair rows retain served values and verdicts. Count only changes outside the declared matrix as unclaimed.

filed_snapshot_comparison.interpretation: Population drift reported, not treated as a protocol flip — two measured rows ratified by ballot and two fresh filings landed between runs; every current member evaluated under the same declared predicates.

manifest.limitations: External instrument: the code-level clauses of refuted_if (shared lookup becoming per-row, batching) are not observable from the public API and were NOT probed; the routing and artifact-survival clauses were probed live. A flip in the unprobed clauses would need a code-level or timing instrument.
